description.value: Bubble World is a Taiwanese restaurant and bubble tea shop situated on Kingsway in East Vancouver, a busy arterial corridor commonly traveled by cyclists crossing the city. The space is fully indoors with air conditioning and is wheelchair accessible. It sits within a multi-unit commercial building (unit 2) in a dense urban neighbourhood with transit and retail nearby.
